metrics.L0: P_min = A_naf: pp_{full,nobottle,noplate}_naf_s10-12, created P_<atom>_k{1,5,10}; pp_cons_roll P2naf / Pnaf_<cond>_k<k>; S1 pp_s1_mix_full_naf_m0-2; read pp_cons_min_read.json
metrics.arm: --rank 32 --psupport --tscale --decouple --imode --rtransport --bbnom --bbnosize --pgate; both roles rebuilt (no reuse: the held labels split both roles' rows); creations k = 1, 5, 10; rollouts pp_L1_roll P2L1 / PL1_<cond>_k<k>; S1 pp_s1_mix_full_L1_m<v> for every v of the inventory
metrics.counted: familiar layout only: S1, OM, 3F N1 N2 N3 N4 N6 (N5 excluded: L0 fails it), S3 bottle, S3 plate
metrics.measures: per layout: S1 (restated, m fixed); OM; 3F D3 per new pairing N1-N6; S3 per atom = mean over k in {1, 5, 10} of the transfer ratio; delta = L1 - L0 with a 2,000-draw paired state bootstrap (seeds pooled, rng seed 0)
metrics.replaced: sim-contact held (fa1b_common.Held) in training rows and the policy, by ProprioHeld (finger width, last gripper command, hand height): on when closing, width >= tau_w and the hand rose LIFT = 0.01 m above its lowest height since the close began; off when the command opens or width < tau_w; tau_w = (min width + 1st pct of close-commanded width) / 2 over the build's demo rows; creation uses the library's tau_w. The read's instrument (held_step, min_dxy_held) stays the oracle signal
metrics.rule: a counted measure BREAKS iff |delta| > 0.10 and its CI excludes 0; L1 HOLDS iff S1 holds and no counted measure breaks, else L1 BREAKS (broken measures named); new layout and competence reported with no verdict
metrics.stop: L1 breaks: ladder stops for the user's decision; L1 holds: L2 designed next (sources checked first; write up options if it needs large new infrastructure or a plan-level choice); 15 A40-h GPU cap
metrics.written_before: any L1 rollout, S1 run or read
